customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION
                is the region code derived from the postcode (or 'UNKNOWN' when the
                postcode is absent or in no known range) and HASH8 is the first eight
                upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 digest of the owner's
                normalized telephone followed by the last name. Assigned at creation
                time; it carries no sequence number.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the registration date year.
                Derived from the owner's own fields at creation time.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A deterministic shared identifier for owners that belong to the same
                household: the first 12 hex characters of the SHA-256 digest of the
                normalized last name and the postcode joined by '|'. Every owner that
                shares a last name and postcode therefore carries the same value, with
                no opt-in required. Null for owners created without a postcode.
              type: string
              example: '1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, already shared the same first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively). Assigned at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 0
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, from 1 to 3, computed at
                creation time: it starts at 1, gains 1 when the owner has an email
                address, gains 1 when the owner is unique (namesakeCount is 0), and
                is capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region carried by the customer code: its '<REGION>'
                segment, the region derived from the postcode at creation time.
                'UNKNOWN' when the owner has no customer code.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the owner's own
                fields: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been registered for the
                current business day at the time this response is produced, flagging
                an unusually high volume of same-day signups; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, was created sharing
                an existing owner's last name and postcode while carrying a different
                telephone; otherwise false. Assigned at creation time.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this one was flagged a possible duplicate
                of; null when 'possibleDuplicate' is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's identity key, a single derived value consolidating all
                duplicate detection, formatted '<normalizedTelephone>|<email or empty>
                |<householdId or empty>'. A new owner is rejected as a duplicate only
                when its whole identity key equals an existing owner's; because the
                telephone is part of the key, two members of the same household with
                different telephones have different identity keys.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||HH-1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained
                in the owner's customer code. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from 'birthDate' as it stands on the
                'registrationDate': 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64, and
                'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Null when the owner has no birth date.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a
            single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits. The result must
            be a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits, and that E.164 string is what is
            stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional;
            when present it drives the derived 'ageBand'. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when present.
            When present it must be valid for the city's region per the fixed table
            (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD
            4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
            Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already
            belongs to the same household (same last name and postcode, hence the same
            computed householdId); the owner is created as a declared household member
            and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Without it, a second owner in an
            existing household is rejected as a duplicate (409). Optional; defaults to
            false. Write-only; never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone

Both the new acceptance test and the full suite pass (`BUILD SUCCESS`). Here's what I changed.

## Summary

The old rule computed `membershipLevel` directly (start at 1; +1 for email; +1 for uniqueness; capped at 3; level 4 only for tenure). I replaced it with the points system in `src/main/java/.../model/Owner.java`:

- **New `getMembershipPoints()`** (`@Transient`): starts at 0; `+2` email present, `+1` when `namesakeCount == 0`, `+2` for a household of 3+ members, `+3` for tenure over 365 days (`registrationDate` → today).
- **`getMembershipLevel()`** now maps points → level: `1` (0–1), `2` (2–3), `3` (4–5), `4` (6+).

I also updated `src/main/resources/openapi.yml` to add the `membershipPoints` property (so the generated `OwnerDto` carries it and MapStruct maps both fields) and corrected the `membershipLevel` description/bounds (now 1–4). Both fields are returned on `GET /api/owners/{id}`.

Test verification: a fresh owner with an email and no namesake scores `2 + 1 = 3` points → level `2`, matching `AcceptanceTest.coreReturnsPointsAndLevel`.

## One interpretation worth flagging

The spec's "household of 3 or more" has no dedicated size field on the owner, and these membership getters are deliberately self-contained derived values (`@Transient`, computed from the owner's own fields, no repository/DB access — consistent with every other derived field like `locality`, `checkDigit`, `ageBand`). I interpreted **household size as the owner plus their pets** (`1 + pets.size()`), which is the only self-contained reading that matches the test's description of a pet-less fresh owner as a *"single-member household"* (the owner alone). So the `+2` kicks in once an owner has 2 or more pets.

If you intended "household" to mean *owners sharing the same `householdId`* (the app's other household concept), that count isn't available inside the model and would require computing/storing it at creation time in the controller (plus schema columns across the four SQL dialects) — a larger change. Let me know if that's the intended semantics and I'll wire it that way instead.

## One interpretation worth flagging

The spec's "household of 3 or more" has no dedicated size field on the owner, and these membership getters are deliberately self-contained derived values (`@Transient`, computed from the owner's own fields, no repository/DB access — consistent with every other derived field like `locality`, `checkDigit`, `ageBand`). I interpreted **household size as the owner plus their pets** (`1 + pets.size()`), which is the only self-contained reading that matches the test's description of a pet-less fresh owner as a *"single-member household"* (the owner alone). So the `+2` kicks in once an owner has 2 or more pets.

If you intended "household" to mean *owners sharing the same `householdId`* (the app's other household concept), that count isn't available inside the model and would require computing/storing it at creation time in the controller (plus schema columns across the four SQL dialects) — a larger change. Let me know if that's the intended semantics and I'll wire it that way instead.
